confidence.rationale: The restaurant-issued Washington, D.C. menu and restaurant-linked Toast menu independently confirm the current monthly-special lineup and omit all three disputed baseline specials. Targeted allergen searches did not surface a comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen source.

confirmedFindings: Chocolate S'mores, Peach Melba, and Strawberry Shortcake are absent from the current official Washington, D.C. menu.
The official monthly-special lineup instead includes Peach Cobbler, Chocolate Birthday Cake, Cherry Pie, Honey Bun, and Classic Cruller.
The restaurant-linked Toast menu corroborates the current special flavors and likewise omits the three stale baseline specials.
The official ordering page and Toast identify the reviewed location as 1308 G Street NW, Washington, DC.

No comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen matrix, full ingredient statement, allergen legend, or cross-contact policy was found; item descriptions disclose selected ingredients but are not comprehensive allergen evidence.
